about.text: Veneto; a cheese traditionally made with mixed milks, hence ‘bastardo’, in the area of Monte Grappa

sources.text: PAT, Veneto; 25-120 days, can exceed a year; soft and crumbly young, grainier older; historically mixed milks, now mostly cow
